title: Tropical cyclone, Fiji, 8 April 2020 (TC20200408FJI)
description:
UNOSAT geodata for Tropical cyclone, Fiji, 8 April 2020 (TC20200408FJI), from 3 datasets on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. HDX describes the event:

**UNOSAT code: TC20200408FJI**  This map illustrates potentially damaged structures and buildings in Kadavu Province, Eastern Division, Republic of Fiji as detected by satellite image acquired after landfall of the Tropical Cyclone Harold-20 on 08 April 2020. UNITAR-UNOSAT analysis used a Pleiades image acquired on 12 April 2020. Within the Kadavu Province boundary, UNITAR-UNOSAT identified in the cloud free zones 1,003 potentially damaged structures. Taking into account the pre-building footprints provided by OpenStreetMap, this represents about 22% of the total number of structures within the analyzed cloud free areas.
This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR - UNOSAT.

HDX datasets:

- [Buildings Damage Assessment & Related Density  in Kadavu  Province, Eastern Division,  Republic of Fiji](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/buildings-damage-assessment-related-density-in-kadavu-province-eastern-division-republic-o)
- [Damage Assessment in Kadavu Province, Eastern Division,  Republic of Fiji](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-kadavu-province-eastern-division-republic-of-fiji)
- [Damage Assessment in Ono-i-Lau, Lau Province, Eastern Division, Republic of Fiji](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-ono-i-lau-lau-province-eastern-division-republic-of-fiji)
